name: @bear-harness/desktop
description: Bear Harness desktop app — SolidJS renderer on an Electron shell.
author: fltb

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:built
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run build && npm run package:mac:arm64:built
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run build && npm run package:mac:x64:built
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run package:win:built
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run package:linux:built
scripts.package:mac:arm64:built: node scripts/validate-product-config.mjs && node scripts/package-mac.mjs arm64 && node scripts/verify-package-boundary.mjs mac arm64 && node scripts/verify-native-bindings.mjs mac arm64
scripts.package:mac:x64:built: node scripts/validate-product-config.mjs && node scripts/package-mac.mjs x64 && node scripts/verify-package-boundary.mjs mac x64 && node scripts/verify-native-bindings.mjs mac x64
scripts.package:win:built: node scripts/validate-product-config.mjs && node scripts/stage-windows-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --win nsis --x64 && node scripts/verify-package-boundary.mjs win x64 && node scripts/verify-native-bindings.mjs win x64
scripts.package:linux:built: node scripts/validate-product-config.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --linux AppImage deb --x64 && node scripts/verify-package-boundary.mjs linux x64 && node scripts/verify-native-bindings.mjs linux x64
